question: Refer to the exhibit. Users report SAN traffic packet loss on a blade server that is managed by using Cisco UCS Manager. An engineer must implement a SPAN feature to an external Fibre Channel analyzer. Which configuration source in the TEST monitoring session must the engineer select?
context: DCNM view: SAN / Traffic Monitoring Sessions / Fabric A / Monitor Session TEST. Properties: Name TEST, Admin State Enabled, Operational State Down, Operational State Reason 'No Sources Configured'. Sources list: Uplink FC Ports, FC Port Channels, VSANs, vHBAs, Storage Ports.
options: all the VSANs from the server
all the uplink Fibre Channel ports
all the virtual host bus adapters from the server
